questions.question: What's been feeling most difficult lately?
questions.subtext: Choose the one that fits best — you can add detail later.

options.label: Anxiety or chronic stress
options.description: Overthinking, tension, worry that won't switch off

options.label: Low mood or emotional flatness
options.description: Feeling disconnected, unmotivated, or unlike yourself

options.label: Relationships or connection
options.description: Conflict, distance, breakups, or patterns that repeat

options.label: Work stress or burnout
options.description: Depleted, dreading work, detached from what you do

questions.question: How long has this been affecting you?
How is it showing up day to day?

anxiety.label: Difficulty sleeping or racing thoughts at night
Constant low-level worry about the future

depression.label: Low energy — hard to get started on things
Loss of interest in things you used to enjoy
Feeling empty or numb rather than sad

relationship.label: Pulling away from people you want to be close to

burnout.label: Dreading work — Sunday dread, Monday exhaustion
Feeling detached or going through the motions
Irritable or short-tempered outside of work

questions.question: Have you tried anything before?
questions.subtext: This helps your psychologist understand where to start.

options.label: Nothing yet — this is my first step
Therapy or counselling in the past
Currently seeing a therapist or psychiatrist

questions.question: How ready do you feel to work on this?
questions.subtext: Be honest — there's no wrong answer and it won't affect your match.

questions.question: Where should we send your programme match?
questions.subtext: A Cadabams counsellor will also call to answer any questions before you start.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Mobile number
fields.hint: We'll send your match via WhatsApp

questions.disclaimer: By submitting, you agree to be contacted by a Cadabams MindTalk counsellor. Your information is confidential and will never be shared.
